purpose: Gate 0 for selective looking. Measurement-only, no learned gaze policy.

ground_truth.note: Use ImageNet-100 VAL split for targets.

target_composition.target_source: ImageNet-100 val image, scaled to area fraction u ~ U[0.01, 0.05]
target_composition.distractor_class_policy: random different classes from ImageNet-100, placed to avoid overlap with target
target_composition.position_distribution: uniform in valid placement region with border margin = 10% of canvas
target_composition.canvas_crossing: evaluate both canvas sizes; report separately
target_composition.compositing_rule: alpha-blend target onto background with Poisson/noise as specified; ensure target visible; use fixed RNG per (scene_seed, policy)

budgets.definition: Pixel budgets per (policy, K) including the gist. Uniform-downsample resolution matched to each (policy,K) budget.

uniform_downsample.description: Downsample full composed scene to matched resolution for budget; input to trunk is that downsampled image (single view)

oracle.description: Glimpses at ground-truth target location. At K=2, oracle glimpse 2 is placed at the second most informative location relative to ground truth as defined (e.g. 90 degrees offset) with same size

heuristic.rule: Attention rollout from CLS to patch tokens on the gist (frozen ff_112). Layers: all transformer blocks; head aggregation: mean over heads; top-K peak selection with suppression radius = glimpse_size/2 (non-max suppression); no entropy-based scalar rule. No learned parameters.
heuristic.topK: K peaks after NMS with suppression_radius=glimpse_size/2

compositing_rule_trunk.description: K glimpses + gist combined by logit averaging (fixed). Same for all policies.

seeds.name: scene_seed
seeds.what_varies: Scene sampling and glimpse randomness. Trunk fixed.

HEADROOM.condition: oracle - max(random, uniform) >= 10 pp at primary budget K=2 on all 3 scene seeds
HEADROOM.description: Oracle must beat both random and uniform by >=10pp at primary budget on all seeds.

VIABILITY.condition: heuristic recovers >= 30% of the oracle-random gap at the same primary budget (K=2) on >= 2 of 3 scene seeds
VIABILITY.description: Heuristic must capture meaningful fraction of oracle-random gap.

pass_rule.note: Headroom alone does not authorize learned-gaze work.
